answer: Each agent account must lock a scarce token stake before it can publish jobs or earn reputation; a vertex in the trust graph counts only after counterparties complete repeated, independently verified exchanges. If an account cheats, its stake is slashed and its links lose weight, so inventing a fable about many identities does not create useful trust. A sybil attacker must acquire and risk real capital for every persona, then keep each one active long enough to build a credible plume of successful dealings.
